claims.claim: 纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例冠心病患者的 meta 分析显示，速效救心丸较对照治疗改善心电图结果的 RR 为 1.32（95% CI 1.26 至 1.38）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 直接：人群为冠心病患者，结局为心电图改善这一替代终点；不覆盖受检者围检查期使用，也不覆盖焦虑结局。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究异质性高（I²=62.3%），多为中国单中心小样本研究；效应量为替代终点，非临床事件结局。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析纳入的研究中，大多数因缺乏双盲设计而 Jadad 评分较低，被判定为低质量、高偏倚风险。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.applicability: 直接：评价的是速效救心丸治疗冠心病的研究质量。
claims.uncertainty: Jadad 评分由原作者判定；原文未逐项列出各项研究的分值分布。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析以心电图改善为主要结局，作者未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.
claims.applicability: 直接：说明现有 meta 分析未提供硬临床结局证据。
claims.uncertainty: 阴性表述仅指该 meta 分析未分析该结局，不构成"无该结局获益"的证据。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸主要成分为川芎嗪（四甲基吡嗪）与冰片，广泛用于心绞痛的抗心绞痛治疗；对人内乳动脉，该药使 KCl 诱导的收缩发生充分舒张（99.4%±10.5%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill, a compound Chinese traditional medicine with main components of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol, is widely used for antiangina treatment in China … SJP caused full relaxation in KCl- (99.4 ± 10.5%, n = 6) and U46619- (99.9 ± 5.6%, n = 6) contracted IMA.
claims.applicability: 间接：为离体人动脉的机制证据，支持血管舒张方向，不构成对焦虑或围检查期结局的证据。
claims.uncertainty: 离体实验，n 较小（每条件 n=6）；机制不能外推至临床结局。

claims.claim: 接受冠脉造影或 PCI 的患者中，围手术期高焦虑水平常见，报道的发生率为 24% 至 72%。
claims.sourceTitle: Premedication to reduce anxiety in patients undergoing coronary angiography and percutaneous coronary intervention
claims.supportQuote: many patients experience high levels of periprocedural anxiety, with reported prevalence rates varying from 24% to 72%.
claims.applicability: 直接：人群为冠脉造影/PCI 受检者，结局为围手术期焦虑水平。
claims.uncertainty: 发生率区间来自多项异质研究的汇总转述，测量工具与阈值不一，原文未给出统一的量表中度定义。

claims.claim: 与无预处理（ΔVAS −1.4）相比，术前劳拉西泮或地西泮使冠脉造影/PCI 患者的焦虑降低幅度更大（ΔVAS −2.0，P=0.007 与 0.003），但绝对效应有限。
claims.sourceTitle: Premedication to reduce anxiety in patients undergoing coronary angiography and percutaneous coronary intervention
claims.supportQuote: Anxiety reduction was larger in patients premedicated with lorazepam (ΔVAS=−2.0, SE=1.6, P=0.007) or diazepam (ΔVAS=−2.0, SE=1.5, p=0.003) compared with patients without any premedication (ΔVAS=−1.4, SE=1.2).
claims.applicability: 直接：干预为术前短效镇静药，结局为 VAS 焦虑评分；但为开放标签、按月轮转分配，非盲法随机对照。
claims.uncertainty: 开放标签研究，非安慰剂对照；效应量小（ΔVAS 差值约 0.6 分）。

claims.claim: 咪达唑仑术前用药未显著降低焦虑，且 19.8%（n=39）的患者出现不良反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Premedication to reduce anxiety in patients undergoing coronary angiography and percutaneous coronary intervention
claims.supportQuote: In contrast, a substantial amount of the participants premedicated with midazolam (n=39, 19.8%) experienced one or more side effects.
claims.applicability: 直接：受检者人群的术前镇静安全性证据。
claims.uncertainty: 咪达唑仑组因早期不良反应被转为无预处理，样本量较小（n=174），组间不均衡。

claims.claim: 缺乏指导冠脉造影/PCI 前药物性抗焦虑选择的指南，术前抗焦虑用药目前基于操作者个人偏好而非证据。
claims.sourceTitle: Premedication to reduce anxiety in patients undergoing coronary angiography and percutaneous coronary intervention
claims.supportQuote: there are no guidelines providing aid in selecting pharmacological strategies to reduce procedural anxiety.
claims.applicability: 直接：说明检查前药物性抗焦虑缺乏分级推荐。
claims.uncertainty: 该表述出自 2018 年发表的单个研究团队，可能未反映此后更新的指南；检索亦未发现以分级推荐指导术前抗焦虑用药的现行指南。

claims.claim: 诊断性心导管检查的主要并发症发生率低于 2%，死亡率低于 0.08%。
claims.sourceTitle: Risks and Complications of Coronary Angiography: A Comprehensive Review
claims.supportQuote: major complications from cardiac catheterization occur in less than 2% of the population, with mortality of less than 0.08%
claims.applicability: 直接但为综述汇总：冠脉造影（有创）的安全性陈述；来自有经验导管室的总体估计。
claims.uncertainty: 2012 年综述的汇总估计，具体分母与注册来源未在引句中给出；诊断性造影与 PCI 的风险未分开。

claims.claim: 纳入 17 项研究的系统评价与 meta 分析显示，非离子型碘对比剂在增强 CT 检查中的急性不良反应平均发生率为 0.45%。
claims.sourceTitle: Predictors of acute adverse reactions to non-ionic iodinated contrast media in CT imaging: a systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: Seventeen studies were included, encompassing 2,576,446 CT-enhanced examinations. Of these, 11,621 acute adverse reactions were reported, with a mean incidence of 0.45%
claims.applicability: 直接：冠脉 CTA 属增强 CT 检查，对比剂急性不良反应发生率可用于该检查的风险量化。
claims.uncertainty: 多数不良反应为轻度；原文未在该引句中区分过敏样与非过敏样反应及严重程度分层。

claims.claim: 既往对比剂不良反应史是急性不良反应的强烈危险因素（OR 11.03，95% CI 2.25 至 53.97）。
claims.sourceTitle: Predictors of acute adverse reactions to non-ionic iodinated contrast media in CT imaging: a systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: history of adverse ICM reactions (OR = 11.03, 95% CI = 2.25, 53.97)
claims.applicability: 直接：识别对比剂不良反应高危人群。
claims.uncertainty: OR 来自 meta 分析汇总，区间较宽，提示估计精度有限。

claims.claim: 高达 1/3 接受侵入性冠脉造影的患者经历焦虑，峰值出现在操作前。
claims.sourceTitle: Virtual reality to reduce periprocedural anxiety during invasive coronary angiography: rationale and design of the VR InCard trial
claims.supportQuote: Up to one in three patients undergoing ICA experiences anxiety, with peak levels occurring prior to the procedure.
claims.applicability: 直接：人群为侵入性冠脉造影受检者，结局为围操作期焦虑。
claims.uncertainty: 为试验方案引述的估计，未给出统一量表阈值；属发生率量级描述。

claims.claim: 苯二氮䓬类虽常用于减轻围操作期焦虑但疗效有限，且可能影响接受冠脉血管功能检测患者的诊断结果。
claims.sourceTitle: Virtual reality to reduce periprocedural anxiety during invasive coronary angiography: rationale and design of the VR InCard trial
claims.supportQuote: benzodiazepines can influence the diagnostic outcome in patients who undergo coronary vasomotor function testing.
claims.applicability: 间接：说明血管活性/中枢作用药物可干扰检查结果解读，为围检查期自服血管活性中成药提供类比性警示。
claims.uncertainty: 该句针对苯二氮䓬类，未直接研究速效救心丸对检查结果的影响。

claims.claim: 《医师法》（2021 年通过）第 29 条第 2 款将超说明书用药的合法条件规定为四点：无有效或更优治疗手段、有循证医学证据支持、患者知情同意、医疗机构内部审查批准。
claims.sourceTitle: Off-label drug use in China after the Physician Law (2021): legal challenges and solutions
claims.supportQuote: Article 29, Paragraph 2, of this law explicitly permits off-label drug use under defined conditions, establishing four core preconditions for lawful practice: (1) necessity, indicating no effective or better treatment alternatives are available; (2) suitability, requiring sufficient support from evidence-based medicine; (3) informed consent from the patient; and (4) internal review and approval by the medical institution.
claims.applicability: 直接：中国超说明书用药的法定前提；用于评价"以安心为目的对无诊断受检者用药"是否满足法定条件。
claims.uncertainty: 为对法条四项前提的学术概括；法条原文表述见正文引注。

claims.claim: 不合规超说明书用药的三种主要形式为循证依据不足、知情同意过程存在缺陷、缺乏内部审查制度。
claims.sourceTitle: Off-label drug use in China after the Physician Law (2021): legal challenges and solutions
claims.supportQuote: three main forms of non-compliant off-label drug use: first, insufficient evidence-based justification; second, deficiencies in the informed consent process; and third, the lack of an internal review system.
claims.applicability: 直接：识别"自备药物"与"医生知晓下使用"是否落入合规边界。
claims.uncertainty: 为对司法判决与调查的归纳，非规范性定义。

claims.claim: 纳入 85,997 例负荷超声心动图患者的大型登记显示，危及生命事件仅发生于 86 例（约 0.1%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Complications of exercise and pharmacologic stress echocardiography
claims.supportQuote: Prior data from a large registry of 85,997 patients undergoing stress echocardiography found that life-threatening events only occurred in 86 (∼0.1%) of all tests.
claims.applicability: 直接：负荷超声心动图（含运动与药物负荷）的严重不良事件率，分母明确。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述转述的历史登记数据，原登记年代与地区未在引句中给出。

claims.claim: 一项覆盖 17 国 71 中心的调查显示，26,295 例运动负荷超声中危及生命事件发生率为 1/6,574（0.015%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Complications of exercise and pharmacologic stress echocardiography
claims.supportQuote: One study surveyed 71 centers from 17 countries, finding that of a total of 26,295 patients undergoing exercise echocardiography, a life-threatening event occurred in only 1 in every 6,574 patients (0.015%).
claims.applicability: 直接：运动负荷超声的危及生命事件率，分母明确。
claims.uncertainty: 为调查性数据，事件捕获依赖各中心主动报告，可能低估真实发生率。

claims.claim: 出现持续不缓解的胸痛，或胸痛伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气短时，应立即呼叫急救（英国为 999）并接受院内紧急治疗。
claims.supportQuote: Call 999 if: … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 直接：为新发胸痛警示特征的急救指引；用于支撑"检查前后出现警示性胸痛不得因已含服本品而延迟急救"的安全底线（读者辖区急救号码为 120）。
claims.uncertainty: 英国国民保健署公众页面的通用建议；引用时已将急救号码本地化为中国 120，来源命题（警示性胸痛须立即急救、不得延误）保持不变。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的随机对照证据集中于冠心病心绞痛人群，以心电图改善为主要结局（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26 至 1.38）；检查相关焦虑是另一独立临床问题，围手术期高焦虑水平常见（发生率 24% 至 72%）。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
supportingSources.supportQuote: Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001).

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Premedication to reduce anxiety in patients undergoing coronary angiography and percutaneous coronary intervention
supportingSources.supportQuote: many patients experience high levels of periprocedural anxiety, with reported prevalence rates varying from 24% to 72%.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Virtual reality to reduce periprocedural anxiety during invasive coronary angiography: rationale and design of the VR InCard trial
supportingSources.supportQuote: Up to one in three patients undergoing ICA experiences anxiety, with peak levels occurring prior to the procedure.

claims.applicability: 综合：说明药物的证据人群（冠心病心绞痛）与问题所涉人群（无诊断受检者的焦虑）证据分属两个体系，不得互换。
claims.uncertainty: 该综合结论建立在三篇已保留全文的独立文献上；"证据分属两个体系"是对文献分布的综合判断，非单一来源的直接陈述。
